author: haiku
reason: I'd rather be handed A: its numbered walkthrough explains why each step exists (why the txn stores a hash of the sid, why the Google error is read only after the state check, why the Redis delete runs after the commit), it covers failure cases B skips, such as commit failures, races and password login on a Google-only account, and it has no open inconsistency like B's GETDEL-before-cookie-check ordering. B's opening summary of the current system is the easier way in, but A gives a newcomer the more complete and consistent picture.
